world: ONE lit object: an adult blue whale whose body spans the frame in the deep-ocean gradient, light shafts from the surface. Scale comparisons (elephants, buses, heart, artery, calf) orbit the same whale so the world never breaks.

intent.xray: s3/s4 render the chest translucent so the heart + artery read inside the body
intent.text: one text system per scene (chips, one stamp, counter plates); title on hook and closer only
intent.timing: rule C18: every event is timed on u (fraction of the line); nothing holds on idle motion
intent.loop: last frame equals frame 0 (whale silhouette crossing the frame under the title)

accuracy_C17: blue whale: elongated body, broad flat rostrum, small dorsal fin set ~3/4 back, 11-12 ventral pleats, mottled blue-gray skin (pale splotches), small pectoral fin, wide flukes
elephants: African silhouette (trunk, dome head, tusks) for the 33-elephant mass comparison
school bus: US yellow bus, black windows band, wheels; ~12 m vs whale ~30 m
heart: four chambers + aorta arch, 400 lb (2015 ROM dissection), not a folkloric VW Beetle
aorta: wide ring, newborn crawls through (2015 dissection quote)
krill: comma-shaped swimmers, 4-6 cm, swarming cloud; baleen = comb plates
calf: 2.5 t at birth (AAD), gains ~90 kg/day (ADF&G)
simplifications: 33 elephants shown as 6 on-deck + counter stamp
baleen shown as ~30 comb plates (real: 270-400 per side)
heart drawn 4-chambered schematic with aorta arch
